description: Create note for companies, people, or deals with full markdown support. Never update or delete notes; creates only. May require explicit user approval from the host. Requires resource_type, record_id, title, content. Set format="markdown" for rich formatting: headings (# ## ###), lists (- or 1.), nested bullets (2-space indent), bold (**text**), code blocks. Use \n for line breaks. If record not found, use search_records first.

content.description: Note content. Use \n for line breaks. With format="markdown": supports # headings, - bullets, 1. numbered lists, **bold**, `code`, nested lists (2-space indent).

format.description: Content format. Use "markdown" for rich text: headings, lists, bold, code blocks. Default: plaintext.

record_id.description: ID of the record to attach the note to

name: create_note
